scope: Fine centers and segment midpoints against actual corresponding old/new host triangle planes, then exact per-host closed front/back triangle-ray intervals for every negative-plane sample. A negative value is reported with its actual sign, not accepted by a pixel-size tolerance. An infinite triangle-plane extension is distinguished from inside a closed host. Visibility uses only fully opaque existing MASS triangles (UVv<=.83); model exposure adds exact opaque blouse geometry. Counts are sampled points, not a global intersection proof. The focused cloth check includes both ribbon edges of owned rear companions and all moved flyaways.
